architecturalLimits: Six LUT identities contain four distinct functions; lanes 1,3,6 duplicate one another.
Farthest-change selector is mathematically a binary threshold: 0..127 -> 255; 128..255 -> 0. Duplicate lanes 3 and 6 never win.

At lit sites (amplitude >=1e-6), phase writeback maps output bytes to equivalent physical phases -pi and +pi, discarding prior phase while preserving magnitude within floating rounding. Darker sites are skipped; raw byte-plane exports remain distinct.
